# AISLO | Visibility infrastructure for AI shopping
URL: https://useaislo.com/

New Platform watch: 14 AI shopping platforms, tracked daily → 

## Visibility infrastructure for the age of AI shopping 

Manage every product feed in one place, and see exactly what AI platforms read behind your website. 

 Request a demo See the platform → 

 app.useaislo.com 

 Pause 

Product demo with example data. 

Built for the places AI shops from 

 Google Merchant Center Google AI Mode ChatGPT Shopify Catalog Microsoft Merchant Center Meta catalog 

What is AISLO? 

AISLO is AI visibility software for ecommerce brands. It manages your product feeds in one place, checks the files AI crawlers read on your site, tracks how ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Shopify Catalog recommend your products, and writes fixes for you to approve. 

Feeds and site health 

## Every feed. Every file. One place. 

You send product feeds to Google, ChatGPT, Shopify, Microsoft and Meta. Each has its own format, its own rules and its own errors, and keeping track of all of them is hard. 

Most of what AI platforms read about your store sits behind your website, where nobody looks. AISLO brings all of it into one view, so you can see what is happening and fix it. 

 Feeds and site health Example data 

Your feeds 

 Google Merchant Center 412 products, 3 warnings 

 ChatGPT product feed Awaiting approval 

 Shopify Catalog In sync 2 hours ago 

 Microsoft Merchant Center 12 products disapproved 

 Meta catalog In sync yesterday 

Behind your website 

 Product metadata 38 products missing a GTIN 

 Structured data Product markup on 96% of pages 

 robots.txt 1 AI crawler blocked 

 agents.md Not found 

 Price and stock match Feeds agree with your site 

 Last change: robots.txt edited 3 days ago, blocking one AI crawler Review 4 issues 

## The part of your store AI reads first, and you see last 

Product metadata 
Titles, identifiers, sizes, materials and stock. The fields AI platforms match against when a shopper asks for something specific. 

Structured data 
The markup on your product pages that tells crawlers the price, rating and availability. When it is missing or wrong, the answer is too. 

robots.txt 
Which AI crawlers you let in and which you shut out. One line added by a plugin or a developer can hide your store without anyone noticing. 

agents.md 
Plain instructions for AI agents that visit your site: what you sell, where to find it, and how to buy. We check whether you have one and what it says. 

 Check your site We alert you when a feed breaks or a file changes.

## Questions 

What is AISLO? 
AISLO is AI visibility software for ecommerce brands. It manages your product feeds in one place, checks the files AI crawlers read on your site, tracks how ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Shopify Catalog recommend your products, writes fixes for you to approve, and shows the revenue that follows. 
Who is AISLO for? 
Ecommerce brands and retailers that sell online, on Shopify or any other platform, and want their products recommended when shoppers ask AI assistants what to buy. 
How is AISLO different from other AI visibility tools? 
Most AI visibility tools track how often a brand is mentioned. AISLO works on the product data AI shopping is built from: feeds, product attributes, structured data and crawler access, and it measures orders, not just mentions. 
Which AI platforms does AISLO cover? 
AISLO tracks answers in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, and Shopify Catalog, manages feeds to Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft and Meta, and watches 14 AI shopping platforms for changes. 
How much does AISLO cost? 
AISLO is quoted on the number of SKUs you manage, the integrations you need and the support you want. Every engagement starts with a free visibility audit.

We run your products through ChatGPT, Google and Shopify and walk you through what we find.

# AISLO platform: AI visibility and product feed management for ecommerce
URL: https://useaislo.com/product

Platform 

## Measure, fix and prove your AI visibility 

AISLO connects to your store and your Google accounts, watches every feed and file AI platforms read, and shows you what to change first. 

 Request a demo See pricing → 

In short 
AISLO does four jobs for an online store: it measures how AI assistants recommend your products, manages your product feeds in one place, writes fixes to feeds, listings and site files for you to approve, and ties AI referrals to revenue. 

## How it works 

Connect 
Link your store, Merchant Center, Search Console and Analytics. Analytics access is read only. 

Scan 
We check your feeds and the files behind your site, and run your products through the questions shoppers ask AI. 

Approve 
You get a ranked list of fixes. Approve, edit or skip each one. Nothing is sent until you say so. 

Feeds and site health 

## Every product feed and every hidden file, in one view 

See the status of each feed, the errors each platform reports, and the state of the files AI crawlers read before they read your pages.

URL: https://useaislo.com/platform-watch

Home / Product / Platform watch 

## AI shopping changes every week. AISLO keeps up for you. 

Platform watch reads the news, policy updates and specification changes from more than 10 AI shopping platforms every day. New rules become new checks automatically, and you only hear about the ones that affect your store. 

 Request a demo See the platform → 

 Platform watch Recent real changes, as AISLO would show them 

 Google Merchant Center AI performance insights and an attribute completeness score announced New check: missing attributes 

 Shopify Agentic Storefronts make eligible stores discoverable in ChatGPT by default New check: Catalog eligibility 

 OpenAI Merchants can apply to send ChatGPT a direct product feed Feed spec added 

 Google AI Mode Agentic checkout rolling out to product listings in the US Checkout settings checked 

## Platforms we watch 

And growing as new AI shopping surfaces launch. 

 Google Merchant Center Google Search and AI Mode Gemini Google Business Profile ChatGPT and OpenAI Shopify Catalog Microsoft Merchant Center and Copilot Meta Shops and catalog Perplexity Amazon TikTok Shop Pinterest Apple Claude 

## From announcement to action, without you reading a changelog 

Read 
Every day AISLO reads help centres, developer docs, changelogs, policy pages and official announcements across each platform. 

Understand 
Each change is summarised in plain language: what changed, where, from when, and who it applies to. 

Learn 
New rules, attributes and crawler names become new checks and better recommendations automatically. Your next scan already knows. 

Act 
Changes are matched to your feeds, products and site files. You get an alert only when it affects you, with the fix ready to approve. 

## A weekly briefing, written for your store 
Every week you get a short summary of what changed across AI shopping, which changes touch your products, and what AISLO has already adjusted. Share it with your team or your agency. 

Weekly briefing, example layout 

 Changes tracked this week Across all platforms 
 Affecting your store Matched to your catalog 
 Checks updated automatically Already live 
 Fixes waiting for approval Ready to review 

## Questions 

What does AISLO Platform watch track? 
Policy updates, feed specification changes, new attributes, crawler changes, new checkout and catalog programmes, and announcements from more than 10 AI shopping platforms, including Google Merchant Center, Google AI Mode, Gemini, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft, Meta, Perplexity, Amazon and TikTok Shop. 
How does AISLO stay up to date? 
AISLO reads platform documentation, changelogs, help centres and announcements every day. When something changes, it updates its checks and recommendations automatically, so your next scan already reflects the new rules. 
Will I be told when a change affects my store? 
Yes. Each change is matched against your feeds, products and site files. You get an alert only when it affects you, with the fix ready to approve.

URL: https://useaislo.com/pricing

Pricing 

## Priced on your catalog, not on seats 

AISLO is quoted on three things: how many SKUs you manage, which integrations you need, and the support you want. Every engagement starts with a free visibility audit. 

 Build your quote Book your free audit → 

## What shapes your price 

SKUs 
Every SKU is tracked in AI answers, checked in each feed and kept in sync with your site, so price follows the size of your catalog. 

Integrations 
The feed destinations, store platforms and data tools AISLO connects to. Most brands start with three to five. 

Support 
From guided onboarding to a named specialist who runs your approvals and reporting with you. 

## Catalog size 
Quotes are set by SKU band. Variants count as SKUs when they have their own identifier. 

 Up to 1,000 SKUs Independent brands and focused catalogs. 
 1,000 to 10,000 SKUs Growing brands across several categories. 
 10,000 to 100,000 SKUs Retailers, marketplace sellers and multi-brand groups. 
 Over 100,000 SKUs Large retailers and enterprise catalogs.

## Questions 

How is AISLO priced? 
AISLO is priced on three things: the number of SKUs you manage, the integrations you need, and the level of support you want. We send a tailored quote after a free visibility audit of your catalog. 
Why do you price by SKU? 
The work AISLO does grows with your catalog: every SKU is tracked in AI answers, checked in each feed and kept in sync with your site. Pricing by SKU means you pay for the catalog you actually run, not for seats or features you do not use. 
What counts as an integration? 
Each place AISLO reads from or sends to: feed destinations such as Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT and Meta, your store platform or PIM, and measurement tools such as Google Analytics. Most brands start with three to five. 
Is there a free trial? 
Every engagement starts with a free visibility audit. We scan your top products across ChatGPT, Google AI and Shopify Catalog, check your feeds and site files, and walk you through the results. You keep the report. 
Do you charge per user? 
No. Every plan includes unlimited team seats, so marketing, ecommerce and development can all work in AISLO. 
How long are agreements? 
Agreements are usually annual. Ask us about shorter terms for smaller catalogs. 
Will AISLO change my store or listings? 
Only with your approval. Every fix is shown to you first, and you can approve, edit or skip it. Search Console and Analytics are connected read only.

# About AISLO: ecommerce technologists building AI visibility software
URL: https://useaislo.com/about

About 

## We help brands get found by the AI that shops for their customers 

## Technologists who have run ecommerce 

AISLO is built by engineers, data specialists and product people who have spent their careers inside ecommerce: building storefronts, running product feeds and marketplaces, and growing online brands across markets. 

When shoppers started asking AI assistants what to buy, we went looking for a tool that could show how our products were being described, and fix it. None of them did what we needed. The tools we tried counted brand mentions. They did not touch the product feeds, structured data or crawler rules that decide what AI recommends, and none could tell us whether any of it made money. 

So we built the tool we wanted. AISLO treats AI visibility as an ecommerce problem, built by people who understand both the technology and the store. 

## What we bring 

Ecommerce operations 
Catalogs, product feeds, marketplaces, merchandising and checkout. We know how a store really runs, and where product data goes wrong. 

Search and data engineering 
Crawlers, structured data, feed specifications, analytics and attribution. The technical layer AI platforms read before they read your pages. 

Product craft 
Tools that busy ecommerce teams actually use: clear, fast, and built around approving the right fix, not reading another report. 

## What we believe 

You stay in control 
We suggest. You decide. Nothing reaches your store, feeds or listings without your approval. 

Show the hidden layer 
The files and fields AI reads should be as easy to check as your homepage. 

Play by each platform's rules 
We follow the feed specifications and policies of every platform we work with. No tricks that get a brand delisted. 

Built by operators 
We have run ecommerce ourselves. Every feature exists because a store needed it. 

## The company 

 Legal name AISLO Technologies Ltd 

 Registered in United Kingdom 

 Email hello@useaislo.com 

 Press and partnerships Contact us

# Security and Trust Center | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/security

Trust Center 

## Your data, your approval, your call 

AISLO works with your store and your Google accounts. Here is exactly what we access, what we do with it, and how you stay in control. 

Read-only analytics 
Search Console and Google Analytics are connected with read-only access. We use them to see how shoppers reach you from AI platforms. We never write to them. 

Approval before changes 
Where AISLO can update your Merchant Center, store catalog or feeds, every change is shown to you first. Nothing is sent until you approve it, and each approval is logged. 

Limited use of Google data 
Data from Google APIs is used only to provide AISLO's features to you. It is never sold, never used for advertising, and never used to train general AI models. See our Privacy Policy . 

Deletion on request 
Disconnect any account at any time from your settings or from the provider's own security page. Ask us and we delete the data we hold from that account. 

## What we access, and why 

 Connection Access Why we need it 

 Google Merchant Center Read, and write after your approval Check feed status and errors, and apply fixes you approve 

 Google Search Console Read only See how your pages are indexed and found 

 Google Analytics Read only Measure sessions and orders from AI platforms 

 Shopify Read, and write after your approval Read your catalog and apply approved product fixes 

 ChatGPT product feeds Feed delivery after your approval Send your product feed to ChatGPT shopping 

## How we protect it 

Data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest. Access tokens for your connected accounts are stored encrypted and used only by the services that need them. Staff access to customer data is limited to the people who need it to support you. 

Found a security issue or have a question about how we handle data? Email hello@useaislo.com with "Security" in the subject line and we will respond promptly.

## Questions 

What is the best AI visibility tool for ecommerce? 
For brands that sell products online, AISLO is built for the job: it tracks AI answers and also manages product feeds, checks structured data, robots.txt and agents.md, writes fixes for approval and ties AI referrals to revenue. General AI visibility tools such as Peec AI, Profound, Otterly.AI, AthenaHQ and Scrunch focus on prompt tracking and content. 
Do AI visibility tools manage product feeds? 
Most do not list feed management. Peec AI can import a catalog from Shopify or a CSV, and AthenaHQ lists a Shopify integration. AISLO manages feeds to Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft and Meta in one view. 
How did you compare the tools? 
We used each vendor's public pricing and product pages, checked on 25 November 2026. Where a feature is not mentioned we say Not listed rather than guess.

## AISLO vs AthenaHQ 

Short answer 
AthenaHQ is a generative engine optimisation platform with wide engine coverage and content tools. AthenaHQ helps you write content AI engines cite. AISLO fixes the product data underneath: feeds, attributes, markup and crawler access, then measures orders. If you sell products online, AISLO covers the work that decides whether AI recommends them.

## Why ecommerce teams choose AISLO 

Feeds, not just mentions 
AI shopping ranks products from feed and catalog data. AISLO manages your feeds to Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft and Meta in one place, and alerts you when one breaks. 

The hidden layer, checked 
Product metadata, structured data, robots.txt and agents.md are checked on every scan, so a plugin update or a missing GTIN does not quietly hide your products. 

Revenue, not vanity metrics 
AISLO matches AI referral sessions to orders, so you can see which fixes paid for themselves, product by product. 

## When AthenaHQ may suit you better 

Choose AthenaHQ if your main gap is editorial content and you want one tool to research, write and track it across many engines. 

## Questions 

What is the difference between AISLO and AthenaHQ? 
AthenaHQ helps you write content AI engines cite. AISLO fixes the product data underneath: feeds, attributes, markup and crawler access, then measures orders. 
Is AISLO an alternative to AthenaHQ? 
Yes, for ecommerce brands. AISLO covers AI answer tracking like AthenaHQ, and adds product feed management, site health checks for structured data, robots.txt and agents.md, approved fixes, and revenue from AI referrals. 
When is AthenaHQ the better choice? 
AthenaHQ may suit you better if your main gap is editorial content and you want one tool to research, write and track it across many engines. 
How do I switch to AISLO? 
Request a demo. We run an audit of your products, feeds and site files first, so you can compare results before you change anything. Connecting your accounts takes a few minutes.

# AISLO vs Otterly.AI: AI visibility for ecommerce compared | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/aislo-vs-otterly-ai

Home / Compare / AISLO vs Otterly.AI 

## AISLO vs Otterly.AI

# AI shopping and AI visibility glossary | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/glossary

Home / Guides / Glossary 

## AI shopping glossary 

The terms that come up when you work on how AI assistants find and recommend your products, defined in one sentence each. 

AI visibility 
How often, and how accurately, AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Perplexity mention and recommend a brand or its products. 

Generative engine optimisation (GEO) 
The practice of improving how content and products appear in answers written by AI assistants, as opposed to ranked links on a search results page. 

AI shopping 
Product discovery and buying inside AI assistants, such as ChatGPT shopping results, Google AI Mode product panels and Shopify Agentic Storefronts. 

Product feed 
A structured file or API stream of a store's products, with fields such as ID, title, price, availability, brand and GTIN, sent to platforms like Google Merchant Center or ChatGPT. 

Feed destination 
A platform that receives a product feed, for example Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft Merchant Center or Meta catalog. 

Google Merchant Center 
Google's tool for submitting product data. Its listings feed the Shopping Graph that powers Google AI Mode shopping, AI Overviews and Gemini. 

Shopping Graph 
Google's product dataset, with more than 50 billion listings, used by AI Mode and Google Shopping to answer shopping questions. 

Shopify Catalog 
Shopify's structured product data system that makes eligible merchants' products discoverable in AI channels such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Mode through Agentic Storefronts. 

Agentic checkout 
A purchase completed by an AI assistant on the shopper's behalf, after the shopper confirms, without leaving the conversation. 

Structured data 
Machine-readable markup, usually schema.org Product markup, that tells crawlers a product's price, availability, brand, identifiers and reviews. 

GTIN 
Global Trade Item Number: the barcode identifier platforms use to match a product to reviews, comparisons and other sellers. 

robots.txt 
A file at the root of a website that tells crawlers, including AI crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, which pages they may read. 

agents.md 
A plain-language file for AI agents that visit a site, describing what the business sells, where to find it and how to buy. 

llms.txt 
A markdown file at the root of a website that gives AI models a short guide to the site's most useful pages. 

Share of AI answers 
The percentage of tracked AI answers for a set of questions that mention or recommend a brand. 

SKU 
Stock keeping unit: one sellable item, including each variant that has its own identifier. AISLO is priced by the number of SKUs it manages.

# The AI product feed checklist for online stores | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/guide-ai-product-feed-checklist

Home / Guides / The AI product feed checklist for online stores 

## The AI product feed checklist for online stores 

By the AISLO team. Updated 25 November 2026. 

Short answer 
AI shopping platforms build answers from your product feed, so every product needs a unique ID, a descriptive title, a full description, price, availability, brand, GTIN, clear images, a product link and its key attributes such as size, colour and material. Then keep feeds in sync with your site and check them weekly. 

Key points 
Feeds now supply AI assistants as well as search engines. 
The same core attributes serve Merchant Center, ChatGPT and Shopify Catalog. 
Price and stock must agree between your feed and your site. 
Check every destination weekly; errors often appear without warning. 
 Short answer Where do your product feeds go? Which attributes does every product need? What should I check every week? Questions 

## Where do your product feeds go? 

 Destination What it feeds How products get there 

 Google Merchant Center Shopping Graph, AI Mode, AI Overviews, Gemini, free listings and ads Feed file, API or platform sync 

 ChatGPT ChatGPT shopping results and Instant Checkout Direct product feed (by application) or Shopify Catalog 

 Shopify Catalog ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, AI Mode and the Gemini app through Agentic Storefronts Automatic for eligible Shopify stores 

 Microsoft Merchant Center Bing shopping and Microsoft surfaces Feed file or import from Google 

 Meta catalog Shops and ads on Facebook and Instagram Feed file, pixel or platform sync 

## Which attributes does every product need? 

 Unique ID Stable across every feed and never reused. 

 Descriptive title What it is, then brand, size, colour or material. Not just a product name. 

 Full description Plain facts a shopper would ask about: use, ingredients or materials, dimensions, care. 

 Price and availability Matching your site exactly, including sale prices and dates. 

 Brand and GTIN Identifiers are how platforms match your product to reviews and comparisons. 

 Images A clear main image, plus extra angles. No text overlays on the main image. 

 Product link To a live, crawlable page with matching structured data. 

 Variant attributes Size, colour, material and pattern on each variant, grouped with an item group ID. 

 Category The platform's product category, not just your own collection name. 

 Shipping and returns Costs, times and return window, so assistants can answer delivery questions. 

## What should I check every week? 

Disapproved and warned products in each destination. 

Price and stock mismatches between feed and site. 

New products missing GTIN or key attributes. 

Changes to robots.txt or structured data after site updates. 

Which products AI assistants actually recommend, and for which questions. 

AISLO runs these checks across all five destinations and alerts you when something breaks. See feeds and site health . 

## Questions 

Is one feed enough for every AI platform? 
The core attributes overlap, but each destination has its own format, rules and errors. Build from one clean source of product data, then check each destination separately. 
What is the most common feed error? 
Mismatched price or availability between the feed and the product page, followed by missing identifiers such as GTIN. 
Do Shopify stores need a separate ChatGPT feed? 
Eligible Shopify stores are discoverable in ChatGPT through Shopify Catalog. Non-Shopify merchants can apply to OpenAI for a direct product feed. 
How often should feeds update? 
As often as price and stock change. Daily is a minimum for most stores; fast-moving stock needs more frequent updates.

 Product-level visibility: which of your products appear, for which questions, next to which competitors.

 Site health: checks on product metadata, structured data, robots.txt and agents.md.

# How to get your products recommended in ChatGPT shopping | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/guide-chatgpt-shopping-product-recommendations

Home / Guides / How to get your products recommended in ChatGPT shopping 

## How to get your products recommended in ChatGPT shopping 

By the AISLO team. Updated 25 November 2026. 

Short answer 
ChatGPT picks products itself; they are not ads. It weighs your query against product data such as price and description from merchants and third parties. To be recommended, let OpenAI's search crawler in, publish complete structured data, send a product feed (directly or through Shopify Catalog) and write titles that match how shoppers ask. 

Key points 
Product results in ChatGPT are selected by ChatGPT and are not ads. 
ChatGPT uses structured metadata like price and description from first-party and third-party sources. 
Merchants can apply to send OpenAI a direct product feed. 
Eligible Shopify stores are discoverable in ChatGPT through Shopify Catalog. 
 Short answer How does ChatGPT choose which products to show? How do I get my products recommended in ChatGPT? How do I measure sales from ChatGPT? Questions 

## How does ChatGPT choose which products to show? 

OpenAI says product results are selected independently by ChatGPT, are not ads and are not influenced by OpenAI partnerships. A product appears when ChatGPT judges it relevant to the shopper's intent, using the question plus context such as Memory. When deciding, it considers structured metadata from first-party and third-party providers, for example price and product description, along with other third-party content. 

ChatGPT can also show review summaries generated from reviews on public websites, and labels such as "Budget-friendly". For some eligible products and merchants it offers Instant Checkout inside ChatGPT. 

## How do I get my products recommended in ChatGPT? 

 Let OpenAI's search crawler in. Check that robots.txt does not block OAI-SearchBot. See our robots.txt guide . 

 Publish complete product structured data. Price, availability, brand, GTIN, images and reviews in Product markup on every product page. 

 Send a product feed. OpenAI invites merchants to apply for a direct product feed so ChatGPT reflects current product information. On Shopify, eligible stores are discoverable through Shopify Catalog by default. 

 Write titles and attributes the way shoppers ask. "Linen shirt, relaxed fit, breathable, sand" matches more questions than "Linen shirt". 

 Earn reviews on public sites. ChatGPT's review summaries come from public websites, so reviews that only live behind a login do not help. 

 Keep price and stock in sync. A feed that disagrees with your site gives ChatGPT a reason to pick another merchant. 

 Track the questions that matter. Run your category's real questions regularly and record which products appear, in what position, against which competitors. 

## How do I measure sales from ChatGPT? 

Shopify says orders that come through its ChatGPT integration appear in the Shopify admin with ChatGPT referral attribution. For other stacks, tag ChatGPT referral sessions in your analytics and match them to orders. AISLO does this for you by platform and product. 

## Questions 

Can I pay to appear in ChatGPT shopping results? 
No. OpenAI says product results are selected independently and are not ads. Ads in ChatGPT are shown separately. 
How do I submit products to ChatGPT? 
OpenAI lets merchants apply to provide a direct product feed. Eligible Shopify merchants are discoverable through Shopify Catalog without a separate integration. 
Does robots.txt affect ChatGPT shopping? 
It can. If OAI-SearchBot is blocked, ChatGPT search cannot read your pages directly. Check the file after every plugin or theme change. 
How long does it take to show up? 
There is no published timeline. Fixing feed errors and structured data is the fastest lever because it changes the data ChatGPT already reads.

 Shopify: How agentic commerce works 
 Shopify: Agentic commerce momentum

# How to get your products into Google AI Mode shopping | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/guide-google-ai-mode-shopping

Home / Guides / How to get your products into Google AI Mode shopping 

## How to get your products into Google AI Mode shopping 

By the AISLO team. Updated 25 November 2026. 

Short answer 
Google AI Mode shopping combines Gemini with the Shopping Graph, Google's product dataset of more than 50 billion listings. Products reach it through Google Merchant Center. To show up, keep your Merchant Center feed complete and accurate, fill every product attribute, match it with on-page structured data and fix disapprovals quickly. 

Key points 
AI Mode shopping is powered by Gemini plus the Shopping Graph. 
Google says about 2 billion listings are refreshed every hour. 
Your Merchant Center feed is the main way products reach AI Mode. 
Merchant Center is adding AI performance insights and an attribute completeness score. 
 Short answer How does Google AI Mode choose products? How do I get my products into AI Mode shopping? Is AI Mode different from Google Shopping ads? Questions 

## How does Google AI Mode choose products? 

Google describes AI Mode shopping as Gemini working with the Shopping Graph. The Shopping Graph holds more than 50 billion product listings, with around 2 billion refreshed every hour, each with details such as reviews, prices, colour options and availability. When a shopper asks a question, AI Mode builds a panel of products that match the request. 

Those listings come from Google Merchant Center. In May 2026 Google announced AI performance insights in Merchant Center to show how products are discovered in AI Mode, AI Overviews and the Gemini app, along with an attribute completeness score that flags products missing structured attributes. 

## How do I get my products into AI Mode shopping? 

 Connect a clean Merchant Center feed. Fix every disapproval and warning first; a disapproved product cannot be shown. 

 Fill every attribute. GTIN, brand, size, colour, material, age group and product category. Use the attribute completeness score as your to-do list. 

 Write descriptive titles. Lead with what the product is, then the attributes people ask about. 

 Match your site to your feed. On-page Product structured data should agree with the feed on price and availability. 

 Collect product reviews. Reviews are part of the product details shown in the Shopping Graph. 

 Keep images clean. Clear product images on plain backgrounds, plus lifestyle images where the category needs them. 

 Turn on agentic checkout where available. Google is rolling out agentic checkout in the US. Shopify merchants can manage direct checkout for AI Mode in Agentic Storefronts. 

## Is AI Mode different from Google Shopping ads? 

Yes. Ads are paid placements. AI Mode product panels draw on the Shopping Graph, which includes free listings from Merchant Center. Good feed data helps both. 

## Questions 

Do I need Google Merchant Center for AI Mode? 
Merchant Center is how most stores get products into the Shopping Graph that powers AI Mode shopping. Shopify syncs product data to Merchant Center through its Google channel. 
What is the attribute completeness score? 
A Merchant Center measure Google announced in May 2026 that shows which products are missing structured product attributes. 
Does structured data on my site matter if I have a feed? 
Yes. Keep on-page Product markup consistent with your feed so price and availability agree everywhere Google reads them. 
Is AI Mode available everywhere? 
Features roll out by market. Google first launched several AI Mode shopping features, including agentic checkout, in the US.

 Google: Agentic checkout and AI shopping 
 Google Merchant Center: Insights for AI-powered shopping 
 Shopify: How agentic commerce works

# robots.txt for AI crawlers: what an online store should allow | AISLO
URL: https://useaislo.com/guide-robots-txt-ai-crawlers-ecommerce

Home / Guides / robots.txt for AI crawlers: what an online store should allow 

## robots.txt for AI crawlers: what an online store should allow 

By the AISLO team. Updated 25 November 2026. 

Short answer 
An online store that wants to appear in AI shopping answers should allow the search crawlers AI assistants use to read pages: Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot and Claude-SearchBot. Training crawlers such as GPTBot, Google-Extended and ClaudeBot are a separate choice. Check the file after every plugin, theme or CDN change. 

Key points 
Search crawlers and training crawlers are different bots with different names. 
Blocking a search crawler can remove your pages from that assistant's answers. 
Google-Extended does not control whether you appear in Google Search. 
robots.txt is a request, and one line from a plugin can change it. 
 Short answer Which AI crawlers visit an online store? What does a good robots.txt look like for an online store? What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? Questions 

## Which AI crawlers visit an online store? 

 User agent Owner What it is for For a store that wants AI sales 

 Googlebot Google Google Search, including AI Overviews and AI Mode Allow 

 Google-Extended Google Whether content is used for Gemini models; does not affect Search Your choice 

 Bingbot Microsoft Bing, which also informs Copilot Allow 

 OAI-SearchBot OpenAI ChatGPT search results Allow 

 ChatGPT-User OpenAI Pages fetched when a ChatGPT user asks Allow 

 GPTBot OpenAI Training OpenAI models Your choice 

 PerplexityBot Perplexity Perplexity search results Allow 

 Claude-SearchBot Anthropic Claude search results Allow 

 ClaudeBot Anthropic Training Anthropic models Your choice 

 Applebot-Extended Apple Whether content is used for Apple's AI models Your choice 

## What does a good robots.txt look like for an online store? 

This example lets every search and assistant crawler in, keeps private areas closed, and points to the sitemap. Change the training bots to Disallow: / if you do not want your content used for model training. 

 User-agent: *
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /account

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml 

## What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? 

 A security or SEO plugin blocks AI bots by default. Check the live file after installing or updating one. 

 A CDN or firewall blocks the bot before robots.txt is read. Bot protection settings can override an Allow line. 

 A staging rule ships to production. Disallow: / under User-agent: * hides the whole store. 

 Product pages blocked by a parameter rule. Over-broad rules for filters can catch product URLs too. 

AISLO checks your robots.txt on every scan and alerts you when it changes. See site health checks . 

## Questions 

Should I block GPTBot? 
GPTBot is OpenAI's training crawler. Blocking it is a choice about model training; it is separate from OAI-SearchBot, which ChatGPT uses for search results. 
Does blocking Google-Extended remove me from AI Overviews? 
No. Google says Google-Extended does not affect inclusion in Google Search. AI Overviews and AI Mode use Googlebot. 
Is robots.txt enough to control AI crawlers? 
No. robots.txt is a request that reputable crawlers follow. Firewalls and CDN bot settings can also block or allow bots. 
How often should I check robots.txt? 
After every plugin, theme, CDN or platform change, and at least weekly. AISLO checks it on every scan.
